We have four options. Let's translate/understand each.

Option 1: "ظلم بگذار از آن که برباید - تاج از فرق تاجداران ظلم"

Rough translation: "Let injustice be given to those who are tyrannical? - The crown from the difference of the crown holders [is] injustice." Hard to parse. Maybe: "Let injustice be given to those who are tyrants? The crown is from the difference of the crown holders, injustice." Might be about injustice, corruption, tyranny, crown.

Option 2: "وزارت تو همی گفت عدل را بدرود - بلی کجا رمه ماند چو گرگ شد چوپان"

Translation: "Your ministry said farewell to justice - yes, where is the mercy left when the wolf became a shepherd." Hmm. It's about justice being abandoned, and mercy gone when a wolf becomes a shepherd. So maybe about hypocrisy, betrayal of justice.

Option 3: "گر شد از جور شما خانه موری ویران - خانه خویش محال است که آباد کنید"

Translation: "If your oppression turns your house into a ruin, your own house cannot be made prosperous." So about oppression leading to ruin.

Option 4: "ای دل غم جهان مخور این نیز بگذرد - دنیا چو هست بر گذر این نیز بگذرد"

Translation: "O heart, do not grieve over the world, this too will pass; the world as it is passes through." So about impermanence, don't grieve.

So we have 4 options. Let's analyze conceptual themes.

Option 1: about injustice and tyranny, crown (power). Option 2: about justice being abandoned, hypocrisy. Option 3: about oppression leading to ruin. Option 4: about impermanence, not grieving.

Common theme among options 1-3: They all discuss injustice, oppression, tyranny, and their consequences. Option 4 is about impermanence and not grieving, which is different. So Option 4 deviates.

Could also be "Let injustice be given to those who are tyrants, the crown from the difference of the crown holders [is] injustice." So about injustice and crown.

Option 2: "وزارت تو همی گفت عدل را بدرود - بلی کجا رمه ماند چو گرگ شد چوپان" "Your ministry said goodbye to justice - yes, where is the mercy left when the wolf became a shepherd." So about justice being abandoned, hypocrisy.

Option 3: "گر شد از جور شما خانه موری ویران - خانه خویش محال است که آباد کنید" "If your oppression turns your house into a ruin, your own house cannot be made prosperous." So about oppression leading to ruin.

Option 4: "ای دل غم جهان مخور این نیز بگذرد - دنیا چو هست بر گذر این نیز بگذرد" "O heart, do not grieve over the world, this too will pass; the world as it is passes through." So about impermanence.

Thus Option 4 is different concept: it's about impermanence and not grieving, while others are about injustice, tyranny, oppression.
